# spec-kit 1.3.2 templates (verbatim)

Unmodified copies of the core templates from [github/spec-kit](https://github.com/github/spec-kit)
at release tag `v1.3.2` (commit `55264c2f2f2d1146f02abc543cb913dcdf1f9342`, 2026-11-06),
`templates/*.md`. Licence: MIT, Copyright GitHub, Inc. (see `LICENSE`).

They exist so that the spec-kit format fixtures (#186, tracking #184) can be built offline:
implementing agents have no network access. Do not edit them; to move to a newer spec-kit,
add a sibling directory for that tag.
